#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json, re, sys, shutil, zipfile, os

SRC = "inputs/offer_letter_template.docx"
DST = "output/offer_letter_filled.docx"
DATA = "inputs/employee_data.json"

with open(DATA, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"\{\{([A-Z_]+)\}\}")
# Conditional markers (spec names). Not expected in this template, but handle them.
IF_RE = re.compile(r"\{\{IF_RELOCATION\}\}")
ENDIF_RE = re.compile(r"\{\{END_IF_RELOCATION\}\}")

XML_PARTS = ["word/document.xml", "word/header1.xml", "word/footer1.xml"]

missing = set()

def para_text(para_xml):
    return "".join(re.findall(r"<w:t\b[^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>", para_xml, re.S))

def collect_tokens(xml):
    toks = set()
    conds = 0
    # Walk paragraphs to join run-split text (tokens are within a single paragraph).
    for p in re.findall(r"<w:p\b.*?</w:p>", xml, re.S):
        t = para_text(p)
        for m in TOKEN_RE.finditer(t):
            toks.add(m.group(1))
        conds += len(IF_RE.findall(t))
    # Also scan whole-part level in case text sits outside <w:p> groupings.
    whole = para_text(xml)
    for m in TOKEN_RE.finditer(whole):
        toks.add(m.group(1))
    conds += len(IF_RE.findall(whole))
    return toks, conds

# ---- Validation pass across all active parts ----
src_zip = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC)
all_tokens = set()
conditional_count = 0
part_xml = {}
for part in XML_PARTS:
    if part in src_zip.namelist():
        xml = src_zip.read(part).decode("utf-8")
        part_xml[part] = xml
        toks, conds = collect_tokens(xml)
        all_tokens |= toks
        conditional_count += conds

# IF_RELOCATION governance: if the conditional appears anywhere, RELOCATION_PACKAGE is required.
reloc_keep = None
if conditional_count > 0:
    if "RELOCATION_PACKAGE" not in data:
        print("ERROR: conditional IF_RELOCATION present but required field "
              "'RELOCATION_PACKAGE' is missing (no alias/fallback allowed).",
              file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)
    reloc_keep = (data["RELOCATION_PACKAGE"] == "Yes")

# Every declared plain placeholder must have a value (no invented defaults).
declared_values = set(t for t in all_tokens if t not in ("IF_RELOCATION", "END_IF_RELOCATION"))
for tok in sorted(declared_values):
    if tok not in data:
        missing.add(tok)
if missing:
    print("ERROR: missing required value(s) for declared field(s): "
          + ", ".join(sorted(missing)), file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(3)

# ---- Fill pass ----
def fill_para(p):
    """Replace tokens within one paragraph, handling run-split placeholders,
    preserving run structure by placing full value into the run containing the
    opening '{{' and emptying the remainder of the token's spans."""
    # Extract ordered list of <w:t ...>text</w:t> occurrences with positions.
    t_iter = list(re.finditer(r"(<w:t\b[^>]*>)(.*?)(</w:t>)", p, re.S))
    if not t_iter:
        return p
    # Build concatenated text and a map from concat index -> (t-node index, offset)
    segments = [m.group(2) for m in t_iter]
    concat = "".join(segments)
    # Compute replacements on concat; then redistribute.
    # We need offsets for each segment in concat.
    starts = []
    pos = 0
    for s in segments:
        starts.append(pos)
        pos += len(s)

    # Find all tokens in concat and their replacement values.
    repls = []  # (start, end, value)
    for m in TOKEN_RE.finditer(concat):
        name = m.group(1)
        if name in ("IF_RELOCATION", "END_IF_RELOCATION"):
            continue
        repls.append((m.start(), m.end(), str(data[name])))
    if not repls:
        return p

    # New text per segment: distribute. Simple approach: compute new concat,
    # then assign all text to first segment that overlapped each token; but to
    # preserve formatting we place each token's value into the segment holding
    # its start, and blank out the parts of other segments covered by the token.
    new_segments = list(segments)
    # Work from last to first to keep indices valid within per-segment edits.
    # Instead, rebuild each segment char-by-char with markers.
    # Build a per-char ownership of concat, then apply token replacement into
    # start-segment.
    # Mark ranges to delete (token spans) and insertion at token start seg.
    # Create list of chars with a 'keep' flag.
    keep = [True] * len(concat)
    inserts = {}  # concat index -> inserted string (at that position's segment)
    for (s, e, val) in repls:
        for i in range(s, e):
            keep[i] = False
        inserts[s] = val

    # Rebuild each segment.
    out = []
    for seg_idx, seg in enumerate(segments):
        base = starts[seg_idx]
        buf = []
        for j in range(len(seg)):
            ci = base + j
            if ci in inserts:
                buf.append(inserts[ci])
            if keep[ci]:
                buf.append(seg[j])
        # handle insert at position exactly at end-of-concat edge (token start at a boundary)
        out.append("".join(buf))
    # Also handle insert whose index equals len(concat) edge (shouldn't happen for start).

    # Reconstruct paragraph by swapping each t-node's inner text.
    result = []
    last = 0
    for idx, m in enumerate(t_iter):
        result.append(p[last:m.start()])
        open_tag, _, close_tag = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)
        new_inner = out[idx]
        # Preserve space if content has leading/trailing spaces: ensure xml:space.
        if new_inner != new_inner.strip() and "xml:space" not in open_tag:
            open_tag = open_tag[:-1] + ' xml:space="preserve">'
        result.append(open_tag + new_inner + close_tag)
        last = m.end()
    result.append(p[last:])
    return "".join(result)

def process_xml(xml):
    # Replace paragraph by paragraph to constrain token scope to one paragraph.
    def repl(mm):
        return fill_para(mm.group(0))
    xml = re.sub(r"<w:p\b.*?</w:p>", repl, xml, flags=re.S)
    return xml

# Copy source to dest preserving everything, rewriting only the active parts.
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(DST), exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as zin, zipfile.ZipFile(DST, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for item in zin.infolist():
        content = zin.read(item.filename)
        if item.filename in XML_PARTS:
            xml = content.decode("utf-8")
            xml = process_xml(xml)
            content = xml.encode("utf-8")
        zout.writestr(item, content)

print("OK: wrote", DST)
print("Filled fields:", ", ".join(sorted(declared_values)))
print("Conditionals (IF_RELOCATION) found:", conditional_count)
